CV

cl.p1: I finished my apprenticeship with a domestic contractor in March and passed my final assessment first time. I am looking for a firm with a broader mix of work, and your recent commercial fit-outs caught my eye.
cl.p2: Over four years I have worked on new-build houses, kitchen and bathroom rewires and a handful of consumer unit upgrades. I carry out safe isolation without being reminded, complete test certificates carefully and leave a site the way I found it. On one rewire in an occupied home I planned the work room by room so the family never lost power to the fridge or the boiler overnight – a small thing that got us two referrals.
cl.p3: I hold a full driving licence and my own hand tools, and I am happy to travel within the region. I would welcome the chance to come in for a trial day.

cl.p1: For the past six years I have worked as an electrician on commercial maintenance contracts, and for the last two I have installed solar PV and battery systems as a side line for our domestic customers. I would now like to do that full time.
cl.p2: I have connected around 40 domestic systems, including inverter set-up, battery commissioning and the paperwork for the network operator. I also fit EV chargers. Customers usually ask the same three questions at handover, so I made a one-page guide with photos of their own system; our office still sends it out.
cl.p3: I am organised, used to working alone or leading a small team, and I hold a current first aid certificate. I am available with one month’s notice.
